title: Homomorphisms into a divisible abelian group extend across injections
statement: Let $D,B,G$ be abelian groups, written additively. Suppose $D$ is divisible: for every positive integer $m$ and $d\in D$ there is $e\in D$ with $me=d$. For every injective homomorphism $i:B\to G$ and homomorphism $\varphi:B\to D$, there exists a homomorphism $\psi:G\to D$ such that $\psi\circ i=\varphi$. In particular, the extension assertion applies with $D=k^\times$, written multiplicatively, for any algebraically closed field $k$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure].
